messages:
Jordan: Quick sync — Acme Health POC stuck on procurement asks. They want a usage-cap carveout and explicit billing credit language before signing the MSA + order form. Can legal advise on a minimal clause we can add so procurement will approve?
Amanda: Thanks Jordan. Do we have the exact procurement wording? often they want 'no overage invoices for POC' + 'good faith credit if usage exceeds estimate'. If they want it in the MSA that's heavier; prefer order form appendix.
Jordan: Copy of their email below (redacted): 
> PO will be issued only if MSA includes a carveout limiting financial exposure for the trial period and an explicit credit if usage > estimate.
Sandeep: From eng: POC uses bursty inference — cost could spike. We can forward a conservative estimate and gate the POC to a throughput limit. That makes pro rata credits easier.
Olivia: Finance prefers not to change payment terms, but will accept a one-time POC credit applied to the first invoice. We need clear language: amount, trigger, and whether it applies to overage vs committed usage.
Claire: Procurement asked for net45 and a 'no auto-renew on POC' clause. Also wants an exec-signer for order form.
Amanda: Proposal: add an "Order Form Appendix: POC Usage Carveout" that sits under the order form only — keeps MSA clean. Suggested short clause below.
Amanda: ```
Order Form Appendix: POC Usage Carveout
1) POC Period: 60 days from Effective Date.
2) Usage Cap: Customer's reported usage threshold for the POC is set at [X] tokens / [Y] embedding units.
3) POC Credit: If Customer's invoiced usage for the POC period exceeds the Usage Cap, Provider will issue a one-time credit equal to the amount invoiced for overage up to $5,000.
4) Billing: Credit will be applied to the Customer's first non-POC invoice. No additional refunds.
5) No changes to MSA financial terms; this Appendix governs only POC usage and applies for the POC Period.
```
Sandeep: That looks fine — suggests adding an operational gating line so we can enforce the cap: "Provider may throttle requests once Usage Cap is exceeded; throttling will be applied only after notifying Customer."
Jordan: Good call. Add that. Also procurement asked for KMS/HSM language in the DPA — Amanda can you confirm if we can add a DPA addendum referencing our KMS support?
Amanda: We can add a short DPA addendum referencing customer-supplied KMS for logs and key control, but it's a product/ops dependency. Ops needs to confirm supported integrations.
Claire: Procurement also wants esign routing to CC both the primary signer and legal counsel. They require separate Acknowledgement step for PO number.
Jordan: Practical ask: can we send Order Form to exec signer (Acme legal) and copy procurement (Claire@acme) and billing (finance@acme)? They insisted on that routing.
DeployBot: esign sent — envelope #ENV-8921 — recipients: ExecSigner (acme.exec@redacted), Procurement (acme.procurement@redacted), Billing (acme.billing@redacted). Status: sent.
Olivia: FYI — if they push net45 we need to confirm with Revenue; net45 may change deal timing but acceptable if they sign a PO that triggers order form.
Amanda: Next steps from legal: I'll prepare the Appendix + a short DPA addendum referencing KMS and share redlines here by EOD. If ops approves KMS hookups, we'll keep the DPA language narrow.
Jordan: Great. If we need exec escalation for signature routing, I'll ping the account execs. Can we also include a short line in the order form: "PO number must be provided within 10 days of signing to activate billing" — procurement requested something like that.
Sandeep: Ops note: to enforce the carveout and avoid surprises, please give us the expected token/day profile. We can set the throttle thresholds.
Claire: We'll provide the PO and expected usage once legal signs off on the Appendix. Procurement prefers the appendix in the signed order form rather than a separate SOW.
Amanda: Affirmative. I'll post the draft Appendix here in 3 hours with two variants: (1) credit up to $5k, (2) credit capped at 10% of estimated POC spend. You can pick which one to present.
Jordan: Thanks team. tagging @Sandeep for ops gating and @Olivia for finance confirmation once draft is in. :thumbsup:
